title: On the Chow ring of double EPW quartics
summary: Double EPW quartics are hyperkähler varieties of dimension 4, first introduced by Iliev, Kapustka, Kapustka, and Ranestad. The general double EPW quartic is isomorphic to a moduli space of twisted sheaves on a $K3$ surface. They have a rich geometry: they are equipped with an anti-symplectic involution and are related to conics in Verra fourfolds in the same way Fano varieties of lines on cubic fourfolds are related to cubic fourfolds themselves.
